rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matching to a single user before accessing orders. It surfaced all 28-inch bamboo skateboard options and prices, and the user selected the most expensive one. The agent reviewed the user’s orders via read-only tools, correctly identified the delivered skateboard and garden hose, and explained that exchanges apply to delivered items while pending orders can be modified/canceled. Before making any changes, the agent summarized the exact actions (skateboard exchange to 28" bamboo plain and returning the delivered 25ft hose for refund to PayPal) and obtained explicit confirmation. It then executed the exchange and return with the correct item IDs and order IDs, and the tool responses confirmed the actions (“exchange requested” and “return requested”). The agent reported the correct price difference ($7.80) and refund destination (PayPal). No unsupported claims or actions on another user’s account were made. A minor nit is that the price difference wasn’t stated before the final confirmation, but the new item’s price was stated and the user consented; overall, the actions and confirmations align with policy.
